title: 第十二章 剑引仙途
novel_title: 穿书被杀妻证道？魔尊追妻夜夜哄
content_zh:
彦衡道祖闻言，神情温和地垂眸一笑：“猗儿确是优秀。”他只淡淡道，“待宗门开放收徒时，谢家小辈可前往一试。”

    说罢转身，广袖轻扬，骨节分明的手已掐作剑诀，唤出本命仙剑。他眉眼含笑，星眸闪动，对谢清猗温声道：“猗儿，随为师回仙府。”

    “你可真是对我家猗宝儿和别人两副面孔，”安芦冉一道传音送入彦衡道祖耳中，揶揄道，“说句实话，你这是把猗宝儿当女儿宠呢吧？”

    “安姑姑，您就别打趣师尊了。”谢清猗也听到安芦冉的传音，她见师尊赶忙转身，负手而立，瞧见师尊不知所措的窘态，只能抿唇强忍笑意。

    彦衡微微侧头，目光扫过谢清猗和安芦冉，眼底带着几分无可奈何。

    这时安芦冉冷眼扫过谢家众人，眼中交织着嫌恶与讥诮，她唇角微扬，对彦衡道祖悠悠开口：“道祖，有件事，我想您定然会感兴趣。”

    安芦冉倏然转身，冰冷的目光如利剑般刺向谢临坤与荣怀音，唇角噙着一抹毫不掩饰的轻鄙：“二位方才不是还在热心张罗，要为猗儿定下青州薛家那门‘好亲事’？如今彦衡道祖亲临，何不当面说个清楚？”

    “青州薛家？”彦珩道祖眼底冰凉，面色陡然一沉，周遭空气仿佛骤然凝固。他目光缓缓扫过谢临坤与荣怀音，那审视的眼神宛如万载寒冰，带着洞穿人心刺骨的冷意

    荣怀音被那道目光看得心头发寒，背上已渗出冷汗，却仍强撑着笑意，语气愈发恭谨小心：“回道祖的话，我们，我们也是一片好心，全然是为了猗儿往后的仙途着想。”

    她见彦衡道祖眼中不含半点温度，身体发颤，赶忙说道：“薛家虽不及五大世家，却也是修真界叫得上名号的门第，薛少主年少有为，与猗儿年貌相当，若能结成这道姻缘，于她，于谢家，都是一桩美事。”

    谢清猗心中冷嗤了声，面上却适时地泛起一丝委屈，她抢在荣怀音继续狡辩前开口，三言两语便将联姻之事说了个明白。

    言罢，她轻轻拽住彦衡道祖的衣袖，仰起脸，那双眼里瞬间蒙上一层薄薄的水汽，声音也染上了几分哽咽：“师尊，他们根本不是真心为我着想，就是想拿我去换他谢家的前程！您若不来，徒儿就要被他们欺负死了！”

    既然原身就是仗着师尊宠爱才恣意行事，她自然要好好用原身的恃宠而骄打回去，这帮人在她刚穿来第一天就欺负她，这感觉实在是不好。

    这话一出，谢临坤连同在场所有谢家人霎时间冷汗透衣，手足无措。尤其窥见彦珩道祖眼中那毫不掩饰的疼惜与愠怒，更是觉得顷刻间要魂飞魄散，如见天道之怒将临。

    “道祖……”谢临坤额头直冒冷汗，话音还未落，众人还未来的及反应，只觉五脏六腑瞬间被挤压住。

    谢清猗心头同时被那巨大的轰鸣声震住，双眸微微颤动，看向天穹。

    彦珩道祖面覆寒霜，浩瀚威压如九天倾颓，霎时间，苍穹之上乌云如墨浪翻涌，沉沉压下，凛冽罡风刮面如刀割，谢家上下如遭山岳压顶，尽数伏跪于地，修为不济者当即气血逆冲，呕红不止。

    奇异的是，那股足以碾碎山岳的威压，在拂过她时，却化作了一阵微凉的清风，绕过她，再猛地扑向她身后的谢家众人。

    谢清猗这是第一次亲身体验何谓修仙界第一人的怒火，只觉得心脏仿佛被一只无形大手骤然攥紧，连呼吸都滞涩了半分，原来这就是真正顶级大佬的威压？

    谢临坤早已面无人色，整个人抖如筛糠，几乎是匍匐在地，声音因极致的恐惧而扭曲变调：“道祖息怒！道祖息怒啊！晚辈，晚辈愚昧无知，内子她，她只是一时糊涂，绝无他意！晚辈再也不敢妄加安排了，求道祖宽宏大量，饶过我等此次！”

    不待谢临坤说完，彦珩道祖眼神骤然变得凛冽如万古寒渊，声音不高，却字字如冰锥砸在众人心头：“猗儿既入我门下，世间万事，自有本尊为她做主。”
content_en:
Upon hearing this, Daozu Yan Heng lowered his eyes and smiled gently: "Yi'er is indeed outstanding." He simply said, "When the sect is open to accept disciples, the younger generation of the Xie family can go and give it a try."

    After saying that, he turned around, raised his sleeves lightly, and made a sword gesture with his well-jointed hands, summoning his natal sword. With a smile on his face and twinkling starry eyes, he said warmly to Xie Qingyi: "Yi'er, follow me back to the Immortal Mansion."

    "You really treat my Yi Bao'er differently than others," An Luran sent a message to Taozu Yan Heng's ears, teasing, "To be honest, do you treat Yi Bao'er as your daughter?"

    "Aunt An, please stop teasing Master." Xie Qingyi also heard An Luran's message. She saw Master quickly turned around and stood with his hands behind his back. Seeing Master's embarrassment, she could only purse her lips to suppress a smile.

    Yan Heng turned his head slightly and glanced at Xie Qingyi and An Luran, with a hint of helplessness in his eyes.

    At this time, An Luran glanced at everyone in the Xie family with cold eyes, disgust and ridicule intertwined in her eyes. She raised the corners of her lips slightly and spoke leisurely to Daozu Yanheng: "Daozu, there is something that I think you will be interested in."

    An Luran suddenly turned around, his cold eyes piercing Xie Linkun and Rong Huaiyin like sharp swords, with a trace of undisguised contempt on the corner of his lips: "Weren't you two still enthusiastically planning a 'good marriage' for Yi'er in the Xue family in Qingzhou? Now that Taoist Yan Heng is here in person, why don't you make it clear in person?"

    "The Xue family in Qingzhou?" Daozu Yanheng's eyes were cold, his face suddenly sank, and the air around him seemed to have suddenly solidified. His eyes slowly swept over Xie Linkun and Rong Huaiyin, and his scrutinizing eyes were like ice, with a chill that penetrated people's hearts.

    Rong Huaiyin was so chilled by that gaze that cold sweat broke out on his back, but he still held on to a smile, and his tone became more respectful and cautious: "Returning to Dao Ancestor, we, we also have good intentions, and we are all thinking about Yi'er's future path to immortality."

    Seeing that there was no warmth in Taozu Yanheng's eyes and his body was trembling, she hurriedly said: "Although the Xue family is not as good as the five great families, it is still a famous family in the world of cultivation. Young master Xue is young and promising, and is about the same age as Yi'er. If this marriage can be formed, it will be a good thing for her and the Xie family."

    Xie Qingyi sneered coldly in her heart, but a hint of grievance appeared on her face at the right time. She spoke before Rong Huaiyin continued to quibble, and explained the marriage clearly in a few words.

    After saying that, she gently grabbed Taozu Yanheng's sleeves and raised her face. Her eyes were instantly covered with a thin layer of moisture, and her voice was choked with sobs: "Master, they don't really care about me at all, they just want to trade me for his Xie family's future! If you don't come, my disciple will be bullied to death by them!"

    Since the original body acted arbitrarily because of the master's favor, she naturally had to use the original body's arrogance to fight back. It felt really bad for these people to bully her on the first day she came here.

    As soon as these words came out, Xie Linkun and all the Xie family members present were instantly sweating and at a loss. Especially when I saw the undisguised love and anger in Taozu Yanheng's eyes, I felt that my soul was going to fly away in an instant, as if I saw the wrath of heaven coming.

    "Tao Ancestor..." Cold sweat broke out on Xie Linkun's forehead. Before he finished speaking, and before everyone could react, they felt that their internal organs were instantly squeezed.

    Xie Qingyi's heart was shaken by the huge roar at the same time, his eyes trembled slightly, and he looked towards the sky.

    The face of Taoist Yanheng was covered with frost, and the vast pressure was like nine heavens falling. In an instant, the dark clouds in the sky surged like ink waves, weighing down heavily, and the sharp wind blew across their faces like knives. The Xie family members all knelt on the ground as if they were being weighed down by mountains. Those who were weak in cultivation immediately had their energy and blood rush back, and they vomited red.

    Strangely, the pressure that could crush mountains turned into a cool breeze when it passed her, bypassing her and then pounced on the Xie family members behind her.

    This was the first time that Xie Qingyi personally experienced the anger of the number one person in the world of immortality. He felt as if his heart was suddenly clenched tightly by an invisible hand, and even his breathing was stagnant for half a minute. So this is the pressure of a real top boss?

    Xie Linkun's face had long been pale, his whole body was shaking like chaff, and he was almost lying on the ground. His voice was distorted by the extreme fear: "Daozu, please calm down! Daozu, please calm down! Junior, junior, I am ignorant, my wife is her, she is just confused for a moment, she has no other intention! I don't dare to make any arrogant arrangements anymore, I beg Daozu to be magnanimous and spare me from waiting this time!"

    Before Xie Linkun could finish speaking, Taoist Yanheng's eyes suddenly became as cold as the eternal cold abyss. His voice was not high, but every word struck everyone's heart like an ice pick: "Now that Yi'er has entered my sect, I will make the final decision for her in everything in the world."
title_en: Chapter 12 The Sword Leads to Immortality
